subject: Highwater: RCA delivery, action owners, and closure timeline
messages:
From: Alex Foster <alex.foster@highwater.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: sanjay.patel@highwater.ai
Date: 2027-02-20 09:12:30 -0800
Subject: Highwater production spike — urgent follow-up

Markus / Kimberly,

We experienced a severe latency and elevated 5xx error rate across our inference traffic between 08:43–09:15 PST this morning. Throughput dropped ~30% and several customer-facing flows timed out. Our engineering team captured logs and a support bundle (attached).

We need a timeline of what happened and immediate remediation steps — our CEO is asking for a short exec summary. Can you confirm ownership and an estimate for when you will circulate an RCA?

Attachments: highwater-incident-log.zip (zip)

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Foster
Head of Platform, Highwater AI

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Alex Foster <alex.foster@highwater.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-20 10:04:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Highwater production spike — urgent follow-up

Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the logs. We’ve prioritized this as a P1 and have a cross-functional team on it (runtime, infra, and customer success). Initial notes:

- Incident window observed in our telemetry matches your timestamps.
- Root cause looks correlated with a suboptimal kernel selection + degraded autoscale reaction due to a KV-cache eviction storm.
- We’ll validate with a full trace-based timeline and propose mitigations.

I’ll own the RCA delivery to your execs. Expect a draft RCA and an interim mitigations plan by EOD tomorrow (2027-02-21). For now, immediate steps we’ve taken:
- Rolled a targeted rollback to a stable kernel profile for your pool.
- Raised autoscale thresholds for your dedicated capacity to avoid repeated thrashing.

Cc’ing Rishi and Neha to confirm follow-through on perf fixes and telemetry adjustments.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Reliability, Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Foster <alex.foster@highwater.ai>, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-21 17:58:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Highwater production spike — interim RCA draft

Team / Alex — attaching the interim RCA (linked below) and an action spreadsheet with owners and ETA. Summary highlights:

- Primary cause: kernel-selector regression interacting with high-cardinality prefix cache evictions under bursty traffic. This increased per-request CPU utilization and stalled batch formation, causing latency amplification and elevated 5xx.
- Contributing factors: suboptimal autoscale hysteresis + a misrouted health-check flood from a partner integration.

Immediate actions (72h):
- Reverted kernel-selector to known-good (complete) — Rishi — 2027-02-20 10:25 PST.
- Increased autoscale debounce window for Highwater pool — Neha — 2027-02-20 11:00 PST.
- Blocked misrouted health-checks at the routing layer — Kimberly — 2027-02-21 03:10 PST.

Longer-term (30d):
- Add unit/CI test for kernel-selector behavior under eviction scenarios — Engineering/Rishi — ETA 2027-03-15.
- Telemetry: emit eviction-rate signal into the alerting pipeline — Neha — ETA 2027-03-01.

Links:
- RCA draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HxR-highwater-rca
- Action owners: https://drive.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1ACTIONS-highwater

Attachments: highwater-rca-v1.pdf, action-owners-spreadsheet.csv

Please review and call out any missing items. Alex — would your execs like a 15-min readout tomorrow morning?

—Rishi

From: Alex Foster <alex.foster@highwater.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, sanjay.patel@highwater.ai
Date: 2027-02-22 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Highwater production spike — interim RCA draft

Thanks, Rishi — the draft looks thorough. Execs asked for a concise 1-pager and a clear closure plan for the next 30 days. A 15-min readout tomorrow (2027-02-23) at 09:00 PST works — please include a slide with measurable criteria for "closed" (i.e., sustained latency within 15% of baseline, error rate <0.1% over 72h). Also include any customer-impact credits we should expect.

We appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Alex

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Alex Foster <alex.foster@highwater.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-23 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Highwater production spike — interim RCA draft / exec readout notes

Alex — good readout today; appreciate the direct feedback. Follow-ups and commitments from our side:

1) Closure criteria (measurable):
- 72h sustained p95 latency <= baseline * 1.15 — Owner: Neha (telemetry) — verify by 2027-02-26 14:00 PST
- 72h sustained 5xx error rate < 0.1% — Owner: Rishi (runtime) — verify by 2027-02-26 14:00 PST
- No recurrence of KV-cache eviction spikes during peak windows (48h observation) — Owner: Kimberly — verify by 2027-02-25 12:00 PST

2) Compensation / credits:
- We propose a one-time account credit to Highwater equal to 20% of February's usage for affected request classes; final approvals from Finance anticipated by 2027-02-25 — Owner: Grace (Finance liaison)

3) Deliverables timeline:
- Final RCA doc (incorporating exec feedback) — Markus — 2027-02-25 EOD
- Action-owners sheet updated with sprint tasks and assignees — Rishi — 2027-02-23 EOD
- Telemetry alerts and dashboard — Neha — 2027-02-24 EOD

Please see attached updated action spreadsheet. If this looks good, we’ll treat the RCA as delivered and start the 30-day remediation sprint.

Attachments: action-owners-spreadsheet.csv

—Markus

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay.patel@highwater.ai>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-02-25 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Highwater production spike — RCA final and sprint start

Markus / Team — confirmed receipt of the final RCA and the action spreadsheet. We validated the closure criteria and the proposed credit; procurement will route the paperwork once Finance confirms.

Status:
- We completed a 48h post-change observation window; p95 and 5xx are within the agreed thresholds.
- Highwater is OK with the proposed 30-day remediation sprint — we’ll track progress in JIRA (HWINC-589).

Next steps:
- Grace: please follow up with procurement on the credit approval and send the final SOW amendment when ready.
- Redwood: weekly check-ins (30 min) starting 2027-03-01 to report sprint progress.

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear owners. Closing this thread for the RCA delivery; we will reopen if there are regressions.

—Sanjay
